title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-09-25
headline: The Los Angeles Dodgers clinch another division title and chase a three-peat

questions.prompt: Who won the National League West division title?
choices: The Los Angeles Dodgers
The Cincinnati Reds
The Atlanta Braves
The New York Yankees
The Boston Red Sox
questions.hintKo: The Dodgers won the division, defeating the Reds.

hintI18n.en: The Dodgers won the division, defeating the Reds.
hintI18n.ko: 다저스가 레즈를 꺾고 지구 우승을 차지했습니다.
hintI18n.zh-Hans: 道奇队击败红人队，赢得了分区冠军。
hintI18n.ja: ドジャースはレッズを破り、地区優勝を果たしました。
hintI18n.es: Los Dodgers ganaron la división al vencer a los Reds.
hintI18n.hi: डॉजर्स ने रेड्स को हराकर डिवीज़न जीता।
hintI18n.de: Die Dodgers gewannen die Division und besiegten die Reds.
hintI18n.vi: Dodgers đã thắng hạng đấu bằng cách đánh bại Reds.
hintI18n.pt-BR: Os Dodgers venceram a divisão ao derrotar os Reds.
hintI18n.id: Dodgers memenangkan divisi dengan mengalahkan Reds.
hintI18n.fr: Les Dodgers ont remporté la division en battant les Reds.
hintI18n.ar: فاز دودجرز بلقب القسم بعد التغلب على ريدز.
hintI18n.it: I Dodgers hanno vinto la divisione battendo i Reds.

questions.prompt: What did the Dodgers achieve with their win?
choices: Their first ever division title
A place in a different league
Their thirteenth National League West title in fourteen seasons
A new stadium
The end of the season
questions.hintKo: The win gave the Dodgers a thirteenth division title in fourteen seasons.

hintI18n.en: The win gave the Dodgers a thirteenth division title in fourteen seasons.
hintI18n.ko: 이 승리로 다저스는 14시즌 동안 13번째 지구 우승을 차지했습니다.
hintI18n.zh-Hans: 这场胜利让道奇队在14个赛季中第13次夺得分区冠军。
hintI18n.ja: この勝利でドジャースは14シーズンで13度目の地区優勝を果たしました。
hintI18n.es: La victoria le dio a los Dodgers su decimotercer título divisional en catorce temporadas.
hintI18n.hi: इस जीत से डॉजर्स को चौदह सीज़न में तेरहवीं डिवीज़न खिताब मिली।
hintI18n.de: Der Sieg brachte den Dodgers den dreizehnten Divisionstitel in vierzehn Saisons.
hintI18n.vi: Chiến thắng này mang về cho Dodgers chức vô địch hạng đấu thứ mười ba trong mười bốn mùa.
hintI18n.pt-BR: A vitória deu aos Dodgers o décimo terceiro título de divisão em catorze temporadas.
hintI18n.id: Kemenangan itu memberi Dodgers gelar divisi ke-13 dalam 14 musim.
hintI18n.fr: Cette victoire a offert aux Dodgers leur treizième titre de division en quatorze saisons.
hintI18n.ar: منح الفوز دودجرز لقب القسم الثالث عشر في أربعة عشر موسمًا.
hintI18n.tr: Bu galibiyet, Dodgers'a on dört sezonda on üçüncü bölüm şampiyonluğunu kazandırdı.
hintI18n.it: La vittoria ha dato ai Dodgers il tredicesimo titolo di divisione in quattordici stagioni.
hintI18n.pl: Zwycięstwo dało Dodgers trzynasty tytuł dywizji w czternastu sezonach.

questions.prompt: When did Landon Knack pitch four scoreless innings in relief?
choices: Two months earlier
The same day he was called up from the minor leagues
At the start of the season
In the middle of last year
He did not pitch at all
questions.hintKo: He was called up and pitched on the same day.

hintI18n.en: He was called up and pitched on the same day.
hintI18n.zh-Hans: 他被上调，并在同一天登板投球。
hintI18n.ja: 彼は昇格し、同じ日に登板しました。
hintI18n.es: Fue llamado al equipo y lanzó ese mismo día.
hintI18n.hi: उसे टीम में बुलाया गया और उसी दिन गेंदबाज़ी की।
hintI18n.de: Er wurde hochgerufen und pitchte noch am selben Tag.
hintI18n.vi: Anh ấy được gọi lên đội và ném bóng ngay trong cùng ngày.
hintI18n.pt-BR: Ele foi chamado para o time e lançou no mesmo dia.
hintI18n.id: Ia dipanggil ke tim dan langsung melempar pada hari yang sama.
hintI18n.fr: Il a été rappelé et a lancé le jour même.
hintI18n.ar: تم استدعاؤه إلى الفريق ورماها في اليوم نفسه.
hintI18n.tr: Kadroya çağrıldı ve aynı gün oyun attı.
hintI18n.it: È stato convocato e ha lanciato lo stesso giorno.
hintI18n.pl: Został powołany do składu i rzucił tego samego dnia.

questions.prompt: Where does the winner of each Major League Baseball division go?
choices: Straight to a holiday
To a different sport
Into a training camp for next year
Into the playoffs
To a vote by fans
questions.hintKo: Division winners advance into the playoffs.

hintI18n.en: Division winners advance into the playoffs.
hintI18n.ja: 地区優勝チームはプレーオフに進みます。
hintI18n.es: Los ganadores de división avanzan a los playoffs.
hintI18n.hi: डिवीज़न विजेता प्लेऑफ़ में आगे बढ़ते हैं।
hintI18n.de: Die Divisionssieger ziehen in die Playoffs ein.
hintI18n.vi: Đội thắng hạng đấu tiến vào vòng playoffs.
hintI18n.pt-BR: Os vencedores de divisão avançam para os playoffs.
hintI18n.id: Juara divisi melaju ke babak playoff.
hintI18n.fr: Les vainqueurs de division accèdent aux séries éliminatoires.
hintI18n.ar: يتأهل الفائزون بألقاب الأقسام إلى التصفيات.
hintI18n.it: I vincitori di divisione avanzano ai playoff.

questions.prompt: Why is a three-peat difficult to achieve?
choices: The rules forbid it
Teams are not allowed to try
It requires playing in three different cities
It can only happen in other sports
It means winning the championship three years in a row, and injuries and the short playoff series make that very hard
questions.hintKo: Winning three years in a row is hard because of injuries and the unpredictable playoffs.

hintI18n.en: Winning three years in a row is hard because of injuries and the unpredictable playoffs.
hintI18n.ko: 3년 연속 우승은 부상과 예측 불가능한 플레이오프 때문에 어렵습니다.
hintI18n.zh-Hans: 三连冠很难，因为伤病和季后赛难以预测。
hintI18n.ja: 3年連続優勝は、けがや予測できないプレーオフのため難しいのです。
hintI18n.es: Ganar tres años seguidos es difícil por las lesiones y unos playoffs impredecibles.
hintI18n.hi: लगातार तीन साल जीतना मुश्किल है क्योंकि चोटें लगती हैं और प्लेऑफ़ का अंदाज़ा नहीं रहता।
hintI18n.de: Dreimal in Folge zu gewinnen ist schwer wegen Verletzungen und unberechenbarer Playoffs.
hintI18n.vi: Vô địch ba năm liên tiếp rất khó vì chấn thương và vòng playoffs khó lường.
hintI18n.pt-BR: Vencer três anos seguidos é difícil por causa das lesões e de playoffs imprevisíveis.
hintI18n.id: Juara tiga tahun berturut-turut itu sulit karena cedera dan playoff yang tak terduga.
hintI18n.fr: Gagner trois années de suite est difficile à cause des blessures et de séries éliminatoires imprévisibles.
hintI18n.ar: الفوز ثلاثة أعوام متتالية صعب بسبب الإصابات والتصفيات غير المتوقعة.
hintI18n.tr: Üst üste üç yıl kazanmak, sakatlıklar ve öngörülemeyen playofflar yüzünden zordur.
hintI18n.it: Vincere per tre anni di fila è difficile per gli infortuni e dei playoff imprevedibili.
hintI18n.pl: Trzy zwycięstwa z rzędu są trudne z powodu kontuzji i nieprzewidywalnych play-offów.

questions.prompt: How is the champion of Major League Baseball finally decided?
choices: By the number of home runs hit all year
By a vote of the coaches
By the postseason playoff tournament at the end of the year
By ticket sales
By the length of each game
questions.hintKo: The playoffs at the end of the season determine the champion.

hintI18n.en: The playoffs at the end of the season determine the champion.
hintI18n.zh-Hans: 赛季结束时的季后赛决定冠军。
hintI18n.ja: シーズン最後のプレーオフがチャンピオンを決めます。
hintI18n.es: Los playoffs al final de la temporada deciden al campeón.
hintI18n.hi: सीज़न के अंत के प्लेऑफ़ चैंपियन का फैसला करते हैं।
hintI18n.de: Die Play-offs am Ende der Saison entscheiden den Meister.
hintI18n.vi: Vòng play-off vào cuối mùa giải quyết định nhà vô địch.
hintI18n.pt-BR: Os playoffs no final da temporada determinam o campeão.
hintI18n.id: Playoff di akhir musim menentukan juara.
hintI18n.fr: Les séries éliminatoires à la fin de la saison déterminent le champion.
hintI18n.ar: تحدد التصفيات النهائية في نهاية الموسم البطل.
hintI18n.it: I playoff alla fine della stagione determinano il campione.
hintI18n.pl: Playoffy na końcu sezonu wyłaniają mistrza.
